propositions: When tool_step_limit is reached after any tool has been called, pydantic-ai omits toolConfig from the next request while the message history contains toolUse blocks, causing Bedrock and Anthropic to reject the request with a 400 ValidationException

The current filtered-toolset mechanism hides tool definitions mid-run, violating the provider protocol constraint that toolConfig must be defined whenever toolUse or toolResult blocks exist in history
Tool step limit cutoff in bounded recovery (tool_step_limit=16) dies with the same 400 error if an evidence run reaches step 17, creating a blast radius across all armed sites

The steering wrapper approach keeps tool definitions advertised for the entire run while returning a fixed notice after the limit, maintaining protocol validity and allowing graceful landing through the existing output path

After steering kicks in, tool calls are not executed but return a steering notice; the model must produce its final answer from gathered evidence, with the existing UsageLimits budget providing a terminal bound for non-cooperative models
